description: Social media data MCP server, REST API, Python SDK and JavaScript/TypeScript SDK covering 21 global and Chinese platforms (193 endpoints). Pay per call; failures are free.
rules: FeedMCP is a social media data MCP server and HTTP API (not an RSS feed reader).
Read the API key from the FEEDMCP_API_KEY environment variable and pass it via Authorization: Bearer; never put it in URLs or source code.
Use free catalog discovery (find/describe or GET /v1/catalog/search) to verify endpoint IDs and prices before paid calls.
Always cap per-call spend with X-Max-Price (HTTP) or max_price (MCP) and send Idempotency-Key on retries.
Stop on 402 insufficient_balance or key_spend_cap_reached; never retry in a loop.
